Honest case for buying: thin as it is, there is some signal. Last 15 minutes show 66 unique buyers and $7.7k volume, with 28.6 SOL bought against 36.3 sold, so sellers are not overwhelming buyers by a huge margin. The first two minutes drew 71 buyers and 18.8 SOL with a top-5 buyer share of only 27.7%, which argues against a single operator controlling supply. Pool depth of 70.75 SOL is reasonable for a $20 ticket. No airdrop dump was seen.

But the case is weak. Price is down 40% from the 30-minute high and 20% over the last 15 minutes, net flow is negative, and sell-to-buy in the launch window was above 1, meaning early holders were already exiting. Curve data (bundle share, completer share) is unresolved, the launch bot was present, and graduation timing is unknown. Demand that is fading and a coin still in an unresolved class do not clearly show buyers will be there in 30-60 minutes. Base rates for this setup are poor and the round-trip cost is 1.4-5.1%.

Verdict: no strong case to buy now. Skip.

The 15-minute window shows 65 sellers against 66 buyers, so selling is broad and not confined to one wallet, which argues against a single rug but still points to exit liquidity. Pool depth of 70.75 SOL against a $20 ticket means price impact is small, but a 1.4-5.1% round trip cost still needs a bounce just to break even. A launch bot was present and the top-5 buyer share is 27.7%, so early wallets may be taking profit into any recovery. Name and symbol are null and the curve, graduation and bundle fields are unresolved, so we cannot rule out insider supply. Dead-cat bounces are common after a 40% drawdown. Skip.
